text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This summer is all about finding<n>efficient running
techniques—anything<n>to help Ines make it through
the<n>Kikuka Sho without collapsing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, apparently she's started<n>a new side
gig to fill her free time. She<n>seems to be spending
more and more<n>time working...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Still, she remains eager to find a safer<n>running style,
and approaches camp<n>with unbridled enthusiasm.
Let's<n>make the most of this summer!
